archetypes.name: dyn-codex-policy
archetypes.rationale: Codex event-stream fast-fail and retry short-circuiting changed shared launcher behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Codex policy-rejection detector and run_external_agent integration. Check that it requires both exec_command failure and policy-rejection evidence, handles partial or malformed event text, terminates the child safely, writes durable diagnostics, and does not suppress genuine auth retries except when the policy marker is present. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-lintfix-prompt
archetypes.rationale: Codex lint-fix prompt assembly now diverges from shared Claude and Cursor prompt behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Codex-only lint-fix appendix and _run_codex call path. Verify the machine site is threaded from run_lint_fix, shared _compose_prompt remains unchanged for Claude and Cursor, no session-root add-dir grant was introduced, and the prompt harness pins the combined prompt without leaking Codex-only restrictions into the shared prompt. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
